newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch EU presidency to visit Paris in March.
newsitem.headline: Dutch EU presidency to visit Paris in March.

text.p: Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok and his Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo will meet French leaders in Paris on March 5 as part of the Dutch presidency of the European Union, a government spokesman said on Thursday.
The spokesman said Kok and Van Mierlo would meet French President Jacques Chirac and Foreign Minister Herve de Charette for a working lunch in the French capital.
There was no specific agenda, but all major EU issues were likely to be discussed, he said.
The Netherlands hopes to broker an agreement on reforms which would then be embodied in a treaty to be signed at a summit of EU leaders in Amsterdam in June.
